introduction.title: Sergio Asensio Puyuelo
content: I am Sergio Asensio, a Technical Lead with a degree in Mathematics from the University of Zaragoza, with more than 10 years of experience in software development and technology solutions and more than 4 years of specialization in the water and environmental sector.

Throughout my career, I have contributed to and led web, mobile, data platform and IoT solutions, defining architectures and building scalable, maintainable and business-oriented products for sectors such as public administration, healthcare, environment, telemetry, meteorology, document management and monitoring.

technologies.title: Architecture and Technologies
content: I have experience in the design and development of front-end solutions with Angular and React, back-end solutions with Java, Node.js and Python, mobile applications with Flutter, and enterprise technologies such as Salesforce. I have also worked with ThingsBoard and other technologies focused on IoT and real-time data management environments.

My profile combines architectural vision with hands-on technical execution, covering everything from project foundations, data modeling and full stack development to application containerization and deployment in environments such as Azure, OpenShift and Heroku. In addition, I have driven the implementation of CI/CD pipelines, reusable code templates, technical documentation, deployment guides and internal training materials that speed up development and strengthen software quality.

agile.title: Agility and Team Management
content: I work with agile methodologies such as Scrum and Kanban, aligning the technical evolution of projects with business objectives. I apply practices such as Gitflow, Pull Requests and continuous review to ensure quality, maintainability and an orderly product evolution.

As a technical leader, I promote teams built on trust, autonomy and continuous improvement, encouraging collaboration, knowledge transfer and professional development as key pillars for achieving sustainable results.

about_me.title: About me...
content: I see every project as an opportunity to build useful, solid and high-impact solutions. I am motivated by complex challenges, applied innovation and continuous improvement, always starting from a well-defined technical foundation.

I deeply value the architecture, foundations and structure of a project. A strong technical base allows teams to build efficiently, scale safely and evolve without creating chaos. Without a solid architecture, clear standards and an aligned team, problems quickly arise.
I firmly believe that the best results come from combining technical judgment, organization and people.
I hope this website helps you get to know me a little better. If you would like to learn more about my experience and background, I would be delighted to talk with you:

I am Sergio Asensio, a graduate in Mathematics from the University of Zaragoza, with more than 10 years of experience in software development and technology solutions and more than 4 years of experience in the water and environmental sector. Throughout my career, I have contributed to and led projects developed with technologies such as Java, Angular, React, Salesforce, Flutter, Node.js, Python and ThingsBoard, working both independently and alongside highly skilled multidisciplinary teams.

As a technical leader, my experience covers a broad range of specialized knowledge in the development of web applications, mobile applications, data platforms and IoT solutions. My versatility is reflected in my roles as a Full Stack Developer, technical architect, solution designer, person responsible for data modeling and database management, driver of Docker-based containerization and implementation of CI/CD processes, with experience in cloud environments such as OpenShift, Azure and Heroku.

After starting my journey in software development in March 2016, I completed training in SAP (ABAP), Java and Salesforce, building the technical foundation that marked the beginning of my professional career.

During my first years at DxD Applications & IT Solutions, I participated in maintenance and development projects involving Salesforce, REST integrations, Node.js services deployed on Heroku, Java web applications and ETL processes with Talend. This stage allowed me to grow both as a developer and in my understanding of architectures, integrations and cloud deployments.

Later, at Grupo Oesía, I worked as a developer and later as a technical analyst on projects related to waste management and public administration. There I took on responsibilities in architecture, full stack development, team support and knowledge transfer, as well as independently managing the maintenance and evolution of an application for Zaragoza City Council.

At UST Global, I worked as a Software Full Stack Senior Analyst Engineer, playing a key role in the development of a hospital application built with Angular and Node.js. During this stage I especially strengthened my capabilities in front-end architecture, state management, back-end development, code review and collaborative work within demanding teams.

Since November 2021, I have been working as a Technical Lead at Adasa, leading initiatives related to water, environment, telemetry, monitoring, meteorology, document management and public administration. During this stage, I have defined and supervised architectures based on Angular, Node.js, TypeScript, Flutter, Python, ThingsBoard, PostgreSQL, Docker, GitLab CI, OpenShift, Azure Functions and authentication systems such as Keycloak/LDAP, with a focus on scalability, traceability and maintainability of the solutions.

Throughout my career, I have taken on key responsibilities such as defining the core architecture of projects, creating reusable base templates, developing reference modules, defining the data model, implementing Docker and CI/CD, preparing technical manuals, deployment guides and methodological documentation, as well as creating video tutorials and internal training materials to strengthen team enablement and knowledge transfer.

proyect_1.name: Project: Central Register of Non-Domestic Discharges - CARE Wastewater Control Center
description:
Tasks / Responsibilities:
I led the definition, evolution and development of a new web platform for the management and control of non-domestic discharges in La Rioja, aimed at replacing a legacy Microsoft Access solution and centralizing information in a single register.

The application unifies the management of authorizations, inspections, analytical results, case tracking and sanitation fee calculation, improving traceability, interoperability between organizations, and control of users and operations.

proyect_2.name: Project: C-OM (Operations and Monitoring Center) - AEMET
description:
Tasks / Responsibilities:
I led a solution focused on the monitoring, operation and maintenance of meteorological radar systems, providing a centralized view of radar status, variables, alarms and availability indicators.

The platform integrated visualization and analysis capabilities with document management, inventory and maintenance functionalities, improving operational control and traceability across the radar ecosystem.

proyect_3.name: Project: SIRA Auscultación
description:

The solution was initially developed as a mobile application with offline capability and later evolved for web usage, also incorporating notification integrations through Twitter, Telegram, Email and Firebase Cloud Notifications.
NOTIFICATIONS : Twitter / Telegram / Email / Firebase Cloud Notifications

proyect_4.name: Project: Document Management Application Migration
description:
Tasks / Responsibilities:
I led the full migration of a legacy PHP document management application, addressing both the technological modernization of the solution and the migration of its information into a new data structure.
My work included defining and developing a new interface, building a new back-end, and executing the data migration through ETL processes.

proyect_5.name: Project: Azure Functions - International Telemetry
description:
Tasks / Responsibilities:

proyect_6.name: Project: OptimEDAR
description:

I was responsible for the development of an internal product designed to help wastewater treatment plants manage the aeration process online and optimize plant operations.

The solution improved treated water quality, reduced the presence of reagents and chemical by-products, and optimized energy consumption, relying on a containerized architecture deployed in the cloud.
